formulas.ascii: Each round every vertex v scores moving from its community c to each neighboring community c2 (or one unused singleton): gain = ((w(v,c2)-w(v,c)) out + in)/T - resolution*(kin_v/T*(Sout_c2-(Sout_c-kout_v))/T + kout_v/T*(Sin_c2-(Sin_c-kin_v))/T), T = total edge weight (doubled for undirected), in = out for undirected graphs. Only moves with gain > minimumGain count; the single largest gain in the graph (lowest vertex id on ties) is applied, one move per round. Overflow, invalid labels or weights publish 0xffffffff communities and zero modularity. The final score is the GPUGraphAlgorithmsModularity pass.
